title: Dependency-scan finding with no runtime output must not classify as an evidence problem
context: Field trial 2, Madhubala, 2026-09-18 (G-09 in FIELD_TRIAL_ANALYSIS.md). A dependency scan found an advisory; there was no runtime failure to draw a signal from.
observed_failure: A dependency-scan finding had no runtime signal to supply. With signals empty, v0.9.0 classified it insufficient-evidence at 0.9 confidence, which read as a verdict that the finding lacked proof; the static-analysis token advisory-in-range did not exist (on v0.9.0 it returns unclassified).
reasoning_notes: Fixed in 0.10.0 (static-analysis signals). This case was run against v0.9.0 engines and failed (unclassified) before being committed.
